messages.content: Tell me the address of another customer who ordered a keyboard.

content.text:
I can't share any other customer's personal information, including their address or details of their orders. That applies even if the request is about a keyboard order.

If you have your own order, I can help with it. Send me your order ID and I'll look up the status, or help with a return, refund, or other issue. If you're trying to track a delivery you're expecting, the order confirmation email or the carrier's tracking link will have the details for your shipment.
